ui.pwTip: At least 10 characters. A few random words in a row are easy to remember and hard to guess.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.say: Welcome back. Good to see you again.
signIn.resent: We sent a new link. Please check your email.

signUp.title: Create your account

school.title: A school or centre
school.body: NT$10,000 per campus for 12 months, VAT included.

signUp.name: Your name
signUp.checkEmailBody: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to finish setting up your account.

flow.reassure: We never ask for ID numbers, home addresses or documents.

type.say: Hi, I'm Link. I ask one small question at a time, so nobody fills in a form here.
type.help: Tap the door that fits you best.

say.educator: An educator. Wonderful! Teachers and tutors always join free.
say.school: A school. Welcome! Let's start your school's account.
say.family: A family. Welcome! Let's start your account.

help.educator: Your first name is perfect. You choose the name members see when you build your card.
help.school: Your own name or your school's name, whichever you like.

email.help: You'll use it to sign in, and we'll use it for account messages, like a confirmation link.

password.say: Almost done, {name}. Now a password only you know.

notice.say: Last thing, and it's an honest one.
notice.q: Before we begin, one honest thing…

checkEmail.say: One last thing: check your inbox.
checkEmail.tip: Nothing yet? Look in your spam or junk folder, and give it a minute or two.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.say: It happens to everyone. Tell me your email and I'll send you a way back in.
forgot.body: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentSay: Check your inbox. It should only take a moment.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, we sent a link to reset the password.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.say: Nearly there. Choose a new password and you're back in.
reset.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
reset.doneSay: All done. You can sign in now.
reset.doneBody: You can now sign in with your new password.

errors.notVerified: Please verify your email first. We sent you a link.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.exists: An account with this email already exists.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.ackRequired: Please tick the box to continue.
errors.email: That doesn't look like an email address. Could you check it?
errors.name: Please tell me what to call you.
